name: In'yoku no Meikyuu
source:
In this adult hentai visual novel, you must defeat the devil in order to save a certain doctor's world. It has some 3D dungeon exploration such in Ultima. When you encounter enemy events, an animation is played.

[From [url=http://www.legendsworld.net/adventure/year/1997#14526]legendsworld[/url]]
translation:
在这部成人色情视觉小说中，你必须击败恶魔，拯救某位医生的世界。游戏包含类似《创世纪》的3D迷宫探索要素。遭遇敌人事件时，会播放动画。

[译自[url=http://www.legendsworld.net/adventure/year/1997#14526]legendsworld[/url]]
